fields.label: Preferred
fields.description: Show this contract at the top of the contract picker.

fields.label: Your Name For It
fields.description: Replaces SendCloud's label everywhere in ERPNext. SendCloud returns no name for its own contracts, so several contracts of one carrier are otherwise indistinguishable apart from the id.

fields.label: Type
fields.description: direct = our own contract with the carrier (carrier invoices us, loss claim goes to the carrier). broker = SendCloud's rates (SendCloud invoices us, claim goes to SendCloud).
